summary:
# 每日彙整報告

## 📰 今日重點摘要
1. 摩根士丹利合作夥伴Zerohash在申請成為美國信託銀行時遭拒，引發市場關注。
2. 高盛以22.5億美元收購ETF管理公司NEOS，進一步拓展其在比特幣收入ETF市場的布局。
3. 夏威夷加密貨幣ATM禁令將於10月1日生效，對當地加密產業造成影響。
4. Kraken計畫將標普500納入資金交易計劃，預示著其商品交易的擴展。
5. 以太坊質押率攀升至34%，顯示出市場對於以太坊的持續關注。

## 📊 市場概況
今日市場整體氛圍偏向保守，主流加密貨幣如比特幣（BTC）和以太坊（ETH）小幅下跌，分別報價63447美元和1877.78美元。雖然價格有所回落，但大多數主要幣種仍顯示出均線的多頭訊號，顯示市場尚未完全轉向看空。其他幣種如BNB和SOL也同樣小幅回落，但依然保持在相對穩定的區間內。

## 🔍 技術分析解讀
目前比特幣的RSI為49.51，接近中性區域，顯示出短期內可能缺乏明確的方向。以太坊的RSI為53.37，略高於中性水準，顯示出增長潛力。SOL和BNB的RSI也顯示出強勁的上升趨勢，分別為53.78和65.28，顯示出市場對這些幣種的信心。而XRP的RSI為38.68，表明其處於超賣狀態，可能需要密切關注價格反彈的機會。

## 😱 市場情緒
當前恐懼貪婪指數為27，顯示出市場情緒偏向恐懼。這可能反映出投資者對於近期市場波動的擔憂，導致資金進場的動力不足。社群情緒普遍較為謹慎，且對於市場的後續走向持保留態度。

## ⚠️ 風險提醒
隨著市場情緒轉為恐懼，投資者需謹慎評估風險，特別是在高波動性和不確定性增加的環境下。此外，近期有多起安全事件和監管變化，可能會影響市場的穩定性，建議投資者保持警惕，並及時調整投資策略。

## 🎯 今日觀察重點
建議關注高盛收購NEOS後對比特幣收入ETF市場的影響，以及夏威夷加密ATM禁令的實施對當地市場的影響。投資者亦應留意以太坊質押率的變化，以及可能對其價格的潛在驅動因素，並關注XRP的技術反彈情況。

news.title: U.S. CPI inflation slows to 3.4% as expected, bitcoin holds near $64,000

news.title: Fidelity files with SEC to add staking to Ethereum ETF
news.summary: Fidelity plans to add staking to its Ether fund, with 85% of rewards retained by FETH and quarterly cash distributions planned for investors.

news.title: Standard Chartered-backed Anchorpoint begins HKDAP stablecoin rollout
news.summary: Standard Chartered-backed Anchorpoint began an institutional rollout of its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, HKDAP, following licensing approval.

news.title: Morning Minute: The CFTC Bails Out Kalshi in NY
news.summary: The CFTC keeps going to bat for Kalshi while the ultimate prediction market court battle looms, with the fate of the sector in the balance.

news.summary_zh: 美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）介入，幫助Kalshi解決在紐約的困境。

news.title: Bitwise Cuts 14% of Staff as Crypto Slump Reaches ETF Issuers
news.summary: The reduction matches the percentage shed by Coinbase in May, and follows shutdowns at BitMEX and BitMart.
news.title_zh: Bitwise裁減14%員工，因加密貨幣低迷影響ETF發行商
news.summary_zh: 隨著加密貨幣市場持續低迷，Bitwise決定裁減14%的員工以應對挑戰。

news.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit over a market niche that data shows it never took off
news.title_zh: FlightAware撤回Kalshi訴訟，因數據顯示市場利基未能起飛
news.summary_zh: FlightAware因市場數據顯示Kalshi的商業模式未成功，選擇撤回相關訴訟。

news.title: Russia moves to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT
news.title_zh: 俄羅斯計劃限制零售加密交易僅限比特幣、以太幣和USDT
news.summary_zh: 俄羅斯政府將限制零售加密貨幣交易，只允許交易比特幣、以太幣及USDT。

news.title: XRP trading could get spicy after CPI report as futures bets hit highest since October
news.title_zh: CPI報告後XRP交易可能變得火熱，期貨押注達到十月以來最高
news.summary_zh: 隨著消費者物價指數報告的臨近，XRP的交易活動和期貨押注顯著增加。

news.title: Bitcoin market in ‘hibernation’ as perp trading activity sinks to three-year low ahead of US CPI release: K33
news.summary: Elevated open interest leaves the market exposed to sharper liquidation-driven moves, K33 said, as traders await Wednesday's U.S. CPI report.
news.title_zh: 比特幣市場進入‘冬眠’，期貨交易活動降至三年低點，因美國CPI即將發布
news.summary_zh: 在美國CPI數據即將發布之際，比特幣的期貨交易活動降至三年來的最低水平。

news.title: Harmony's ONE Sinks 37% After Attacker Mints 4 Billion Tokens
news.summary: The team is weighing a rollback, which would undo the attack along with every legitimate transaction made since.

news.title_zh: 比特幣在美國通脹數據即將公布之際維持在64,000美元附近，Harmony漏洞影響其他幣種
news.summary_zh: 比特幣價格穩定在64,000美元附近，然而Harmony的安全漏洞影響了其他加密貨幣。

news.title: Binance, RedotPay clash over fate of Singapore lawsuit

news.title: Bank of England to test stablecoin, digital currency use in cross-border finance

news.title: Bitcoin miners earn under 0.7% of revenue from fees in new 10-year low

news.title: CoreWeave surges 16% on $2.58 billion revenue quarter as AI infrastructure demand eclipses crypto
news.title_zh: CoreWeave因AI基礎設施需求超越加密貨幣，季度收入飆升16%至25.8億美元

news.title: Fidelity moves to add staking, quarterly payouts to near $900 million ether ETF

news.title: CFTC Invokes Emergency Powers to Keep Kalshi Trading Despite New York Suit

news.title: Crypto companies urge AI firms to give Bitcoin developers early access

news.title: Australian regulator takes down Yepbit websites as investors report blocked withdrawals

news.title: FlightAware drops lawsuit against Kalshi one day after filing

news.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff as crypto layoffs mount during market downturn

news.title: CFTC invokes emergency powers to keep Kalshi operating in New York fight

news.title: Robinhood Chain hits 11.6 million daily transactions as USDe fuels TVL growth
